note: Titles are copied from the primary PDF (whitespace-collapsed) and checked against the stored source text by tests. strong_terms are word-boundary regexes for unambiguous named incident types; a match is shown to the user as a suggestion and treated as Annexure I. weak_terms only ever produce a 'please confirm' suggestion. Free text can never establish that an incident is NOT in Annexure I; only an explicit user attestation can.
